body.statement: Can \(\mathcal H_{\mathrm{school}}\) construct a nontrivial finite exposure block from the Paluck--Shepherd--Aronow school-network design whose reduced rational program is lossless for the original assignment law and direct-effect score, whose lifted primal and dual certificates verify the unreduced observable-margin optimum, and whose higher-order optimum strictly improves the best observable quadratic bound without altering the estimand?
body.justification: This is the genuine application bottleneck: the finite theory is exact but exponential without exploitable exposure-design structure.
body.gap: The school-data exercise in \cite{HarshawMiddletonSavje2026} is a quadratic empirical illustration based on \cite{PaluckShepherdAronow2016}, not a higher-order reanalysis, and \cite{AronowSamii2017Interference} does not supply an exact all-degree decomposition.
body.consumer: A successful certificate would deliver the first consumer-scale comparison on the school-network substrate while preserving its actual randomization and causal contrast.

obligation.what_is_open: Construct an explicit nontrivial Paluck--Shepherd--Aronow exposure block, enumerate its unchanged assignment law and direct-effect score, and provide a lossless rational orbit/separator reduction together with lifted primal and dual certificates showing a strict higher-order improvement over every observable quadratic bound.
obligation.obstruction: The frozen core supplies only the abstract decomposition handle. It contains no assignment atoms, exposure-coordinate map, direct-effect coefficients, automorphism orbits, separator states, or candidate block. Without those typed finite inputs, neither losslessness nor a strict objective gap is a mathematical consequence of the core; inventing an independent block would change the published design and estimand.
obligation.attempted: The observable-margin reduction, automorphism quotient route, and independent-product tensorization were checked. The first two cannot be instantiated without the school-design records, and tensorization is inapplicable unless the actual randomization factors over disjoint schedule blocks.
obligation.partial_result: The frozen finite theory reduces any fully specified block to a rational primal--dual program, and \(\text{thm:tensorization}\) is lossless for genuinely independent blocks.  The supplied core, however, contains no enumerated Paluck--Shepherd--Aronow assignment atoms, exposure-coordinate map, direct-effect score, automorphism orbits, or separator decomposition from which the requested school block and its lifting certificates could be constructed.  No claim about a higher-order school-network improvement follows from the abstract handle alone.
